note: Set B is better because it correctly separates the Gable finish (P3) from the attachment (Steel L-Bracket), whereas Set A conflates them into 'P3 STEEL L-BRACKET'. Set B also captures document metadata (Sheet Number, Lot Number) correctly. Both sets misbind the 3/4" MDF thickness to the 'Edge Strip' instead of the 'Gable' and both hallucinate a 'direction E' condition for the slope. Set B has more duplicate claims, but its engineering data on the Gable is more accurate and complete.
remarks: Both sets fail to correctly bind the 3/4" MDF thickness to the Gable (assigning it to Edge Strip). Both sets infer 'direction E' from the grid line label rather than the text note. Set B's inclusion of document metadata is accurate but neutral per instructions; however, it demonstrates better text coverage.
